newsitem.title: USA: Koch Industries names new head of operations.
newsitem.headline: Koch Industries names new head of operations.

text.p: Koch Industries Inc Friday announced four senior management appointments, including Bill Caffey as head of operations.

Koch said Caffey, who will be a main board member, heads the corporation's operations group, which oversees and manages the company's main assets such as refineries, pipelines, manufacturing and processing plants, shipping terminals, ranches, feed yards and trucking fleets.

Dean Watson is named board member and president of Koch Agriculture Co, which is involved in a wide array of businesses, including beef production on Koch-owned ranches and feed lots through to grain handling, processing, storage and merchandising.
Richard Fink is named head of government and public affairs and Paul Wheeler heads human resources.

Koch Industries Inc is the second-largest privately held company in the United States and is involved in virtually all phases of the oil and gas industry, as well as in agriculture, chemicals, chemical technology products, hard minerals, real estate and financial investments.
